basis.primary_comparison: canonical hierarchy seed17 versus B0 canonical corrected SHIFT-MAP

interpretation: The frozen hierarchy-only H3 reranker degrades replacement ranking on the locked TEST population. This does not establish that hierarchy cannot help as an auxiliary signal combined with semantic retrieval.
next_research_question: Can ontology-derived structural context improve a separately preregistered semantic reranker when used as an auxiliary signal, without changing the frozen replacement-ranking result?
next_stage_requirements: no reuse of Step 9 TEST outcomes for tuning
